title: Domain Spec
description: Declarative spec for /new-domain, /new-domain-dynamo, and /quick-crud-domain orchestrators. Replaces the inline interview phase with a reviewable, autocompleted YAML file.

domain.description: Lowercase, kebab-case domain name. Becomes packages/{domain}-domain. Examples: invoice, payment-method, shipping-rate.

persistence.description: Persistence strategy. dynamodb = OneTable + cursor pagination. prisma = Postgres + offset pagination + migrations.

service.description: Optional service-app metadata. If omitted, /new-domain will infer { type: api, name: {domain}-api-service }.

name.description: PascalCase entity class name. Examples: Invoice, PaymentMethod, ShippingRate.

description.description: One-line description of what this entity represents in the business domain.

fields.description: Domain entity attributes. Map 1:1 to entity properties + persistence columns/attributes + Zod schema fields.

businessRules.description: Free-form list of business invariants and state transition rules. Drives the domain-business-rules skill.

events.description: Domain event type names this entity emits. Use SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Triggers sqs-event-publisher skill if non-empty.

indexes.description: Additional access patterns beyond the primary key. DynamoDB → GSI definitions. Prisma → composite/unique indexes.

useCases.description: Optional explicit list of use cases to scaffold. If omitted, the orchestrator infers a sensible default set (create, get, list, update, delete + transitions per state machine).

name.description: camelCase field name. Examples: id, customerId, dateOfBirth, totalAmount.

type.description: Logical type. Maps to Zod + DynamoDB attribute type / Prisma column type.

values.description: REQUIRED when type=enum. List of allowed string values in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

labels.description: OPTIONAL when type=enum. Maps each enum value to a user-friendly display label rendered by the frontend `format{Entity}Status()` helper. Keys MUST be a subset of `values`. Values not listed here fall back to Title Case (e.g. `PAST_DUE → "Past Due"`). Provide labels for any enum value where Title Case alone is wrong (acronyms like `API_KEY → "API Key"`, abbreviations, branded terms).

default.description: Optional default value. For enum fields, must be one of `values`. For booleans, true/false. For numbers, the number.

optional.description: If true, field is nullable in persistence and .optional() in Zod. Default: false.

pk.description: True if this field is the primary key. Exactly one field per entity must have pk:true. Use type:ulid for new entities.

unique.description: Adds a uniqueness constraint. Prisma → @unique. DynamoDB → backed by a dedicated GSI; specify which one in `gsi`.

gsi.description: DynamoDB-only. Marks this field as participating in a GSI partition key. Examples: GSI1, GSI2.

index.description: Prisma-only. Adds a non-unique @@index([field]) for query performance.

min.description: Numeric minimum (Zod .min()). For strings, minimum length.

max.description: Numeric maximum (Zod .max()). For strings, maximum length.

description.description: Optional description — used in generated JSDoc and Swagger docs.

name.description: DynamoDB GSI name (GSI1, GSI2, ...) OR Prisma index name.

fields.description: Field names participating in this index (PK first, then SK if composite).

description.description: Why this access pattern exists (e.g. 'list invoices by customer').

name.description: camelCase use case name. Examples: createInvoice, sendInvoice, voidInvoice, listInvoicesByStatus.

type.description: Helps the orchestrator pick the right scaffolding template.
